$comment: Curated portfolio demo set. One entry per demo; consumed by tools/demo-pack (the pack step) and the web shell's demos picker. Schema + per-field meaning: docs/design/demo-assets.md §7. Source .glb live under demo-assets/src/ (committed); the pack step emits web/src/assets/demos/<id>.glb.gz (gitignored build output).
licenseNote: LICENSES ARE UNVERIFIED. Every entry.license.status must read "verified" (with author + url + SPDX confirmed) before this set is deployed to the public portfolio site. See demo-assets/README.md.

demos.title: Littlest Tokyo
demos.notes: Hero diorama; default demo. Has MASK cutout foliage and some BLEND materials — packed with a PNG base colour to keep alpha. BLEND is treated as MASK by the current voxelizer (transparency BLEND path not yet implemented). One 4096² texture is the size driver; textureMax caps it to the bake-resolvable 1024.
